schema.text: Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a mode of travel at least once a week?

en.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a mode of travel at least once a week?

it.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Utilizzi la bicicletta, comprese le e-bike, come mezzo di trasporto almeno una volta alla settimana?

fr.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Utilisez-vous un vélo, y compris un vélo électrique, comme moyen de transport au moins une fois par semaine ?

de.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Nutzen Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike als Verkehrsmittel?

tr.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Haftada en az bir kez ulaşım amacıyla bisiklet veya elektrikli bisiklet kullanıyor musunuz?

fa.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: آیا حداقل هفته‌ای یک بار از دوچرخه، از جمله دوچرخه برقی، به عنوان وسیله رفت‌وآمد استفاده می‌کنید؟

hu.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: Használ kerékpárt, beleértve az elektromos kerékpárt is, közlekedési célra legalább hetente egyszer?

ar.#Do you cycle (including e-bikes) as a m: هل تستخدم الدراجة، بما في ذلك الدراجة الكهربائية، كوسيلة تنقل مرة واحدة على الأقل في الأسبوع؟
